advisories.summary: --Xsnapsync-synchronizer-pivot-block-distance-before-caching and --snapsync-synchronizer-pre-checkpoint-headers-only-enabled are silent no-ops and will be removed.
advisories.action: Remove both flags. They no longer change sync.

advisories.summary: Amsterdam is scheduled on Sepolia. The process now exits on OutOfMemoryError. eth_feeHistory rejects bad percentiles, and debug_traceCall uses the same balance checks as eth_call. Plugin API breaks are listed in the notes and do not change a stock node.
advisories.action: Sepolia operators must upgrade before Oct 6, 2026, 13:53:36 UTC. Use a restart policy, or set JAVA_OPTS=-XX:-ExitOnOutOfMemoryError to keep running after an out-of-memory error. Update eth_feeHistory callers that sent percentiles outside 0-100, unsorted, or longer than 100.
